presentation.label: IMPROVED AMP
presentation.summary: The AMP page reworked: HLD from no hold to AUTO, in steps that follow the tempo; ATK, DEC and REL in fine steps from 0.2 ms, shown as times; a finer OVR; and ENV RESET AMP without a click.
presentation.overview: Improved AMP reworks the AMP page. HLD runs from 0 (no hold: the decay starts the moment the attack reaches the top) up to AUTO at the top of the knob (hold while the note lasts), never cuts the attack short, and is a length in steps of the track: it follows the tempo and the track's speed, and FUNC + turn stops on the step grid from 0.125 to 64 steps. AMP ATK and DEC and FILTER ATK, DEC and REL step 0.2 ms at a time up to 5 ms, stay finer than stock up to 300 ms and show times instead of 0..127. OVR keeps its range but spreads the overdrive evenly over the knob, so the low end is fine. SOUND SETTINGS > ENV RESET gains AMP and AMP+FILT: the amp envelope restarts from silence on every sequenced trig and retrig, without a click, so AMP ATK is heard on every hit. The module is always on.
highlights: HLD: 0 = no hold, top = AUTO, in steps that follow the tempo; never cuts the attack.
ATK, DEC and REL: 0.2 ms steps at the low end, shown in ms and s.
OVR: a fine low end, the same range.
ENV RESET AMP and AMP+FILT: every sequenced trig starts from silence, without a click.
usage: Press AMP. Turn DEC down: the knob shows its time to -60 dB, in 0.2 ms steps below 5 ms.

Turn HLD to 0: the decay starts as soon as the attack peaks. Turn it up: the knob shows the hold in steps of the track (1 is one step), and the hold follows the tempo. At the top it reads AUTO (decay from note-off).
Hold FUNC and turn HLD: it stops at 0, 0.125, 0.25, 0.5, 0.75, 1, 1.5, 2, 3, 4, 8, 16, 32 and 64 steps, then AUTO.
Turn OVR up from 0: the first values add drive gently.
On an analog BD sound set ATK to about 40 and DEC to 100 or more, and place trigs on every second step. Press PLAY: the attack is heard on the first trig only.
Open the SOUND menu (FUNC + MUTE) > SOUND SETTINGS and set ENV RESET to AMP: every trig now fades in at the ATK rate, without a click.

access.location: AMP page (ATK, HLD, DEC, OVR); FILTER page (ATK, DEC, REL); SOUND menu (FUNC + MUTE) > SOUND SETTINGS > ENV RESET.
steps: Turn HLD, ATK, DEC or OVR; FUNC + turn on HLD stops at 0, the step grid from 0.125 to 64 steps, and AUTO.
For ENV RESET AMP: FUNC + MUTE > SOUND SETTINGS > ENV RESET, then LEFT or RIGHT to AMP or AMP+FILT.

controls.name: AMP > HLD
controls.doc: 0 no hold, then a hold in steps of the track, 0.005 to 124 (0.67 ms to 15.5 s at 120 BPM, 1x), fine at the short end, AUTO at the top. It follows the tempo, the track's speed and an external clock. The number is the hold in steps (1 = one step); FUNC + turn stops at 0, 0.125, 0.25, 0.5, 0.75, 1, 1.5, 2, 3, 4, 8, 16, 32 and 64 steps, then AUTO. The decay never starts before the attack peaks.

controls.name: AMP > ATK
controls.doc: 0 instant, 0.2 ms steps to 5 ms, 0.5 ms steps to 15 ms, then about 10 % a step to 30 s.

controls.name: FILTER > ATK
controls.doc: The same curve as AMP ATK: 0 instant, 0.2 ms steps to 5 ms, 0.5 ms steps to 15 ms, then about 10 % a step to 30 s.

controls.name: AMP > DEC, FILTER > DEC and REL
controls.doc: 0 instant, 0.2 ms steps to 5 ms, 0.5 ms to 15 ms, 1 ms to 25 ms, 2.5 ms to 50 ms, 5 ms to 100 ms, 10 ms to 200 ms, 25 ms to 300 ms, then about 14 % a step to 40-45 s. Times are to -60 dB. AMP DEC at the top stays INF.

controls.name: AMP > OVR
controls.doc: The stock range, 0 and 127 as stock, with the overdrive's rise spread evenly over the knob: stock's first step takes about eight values. The number stays 0..127.

controls.name: SOUND SETTINGS > ENV RESET
controls.doc: Steps OFF, AMP, FILTER, AMP+FILT. With AMP in the value, the amp envelope restarts from silence on every sequenced trig and retrig of this sound; the voice fades out just before the trig.

limitations: Built for OS 1.74 only, on Modwerk's Rytm base with the amp record hook (ev_amp_record).

Always on: saved HLD, ATK, DEC, REL and OVR values read differently from stock while it is installed. HLD 0 is no hold instead of AUTO, 127 is AUTO instead of 16 s, 1 to 126 are lengths in steps that follow the tempo, and the others follow the new curves. Removing the module plays every project as before.
Cannot be installed with Env Reset Amp: this module carries ENV RESET's AMP and AMP+FILT itself.
ENV RESET AMP acts on trigs the Rytm schedules itself: pad hits, MIDI notes and the first trig after PLAY play as stock.
With AMP set, a sounding voice is silent for up to about 7 ms before each sequenced trig; a retrig roll faster than twice that gets half its spacing to sound.
A retrig hit that lands less than 7 ms before the track's next trig starts and is faded out again at once.
On external MIDI clock a tick that arrives late shortens the next fade by as much; after a tick 6 ms or more late, the next trig plays as stock.
HLD counts straight steps on the clock: swing does not move a hold's end. When an external clock's master stops, the hold runs on in time instead of waiting for the clock.

Times shown are calibrated to one Rytm MKII (AMP attack 0.957x, decay 0.918x; the filter envelope runs at the OS model's speed), and OVR's curve to that unit's overdrive; another unit may differ slightly.
On stock firmware a sound saved here plays the stock way, with ENV RESET's amp bit ignored.

load.display: About 1.4 points of the audio block at idle on the author's unit, 0.8 to 0.9 of them in the amp record entries
load.conditions: Measured on the author's MKII, 11 November 2026, sequencer stopped, 120 BPM, a development base with a test link and a meter on the 132 MHz timer, three 20 s windows an image: the audio block 65.8 % busy with the base alone, 67.2 to 67.3 % with this module (67.6 to 67.9 % before its idle path was made cheaper, same kit states); the amp record entries 0.8 to 0.9 % over the meter's own. An idle voice makes no C call, the trig scan returns after reading the queue's times while nothing is near, and the OVR reader reuses its last answer. Not measured with a pattern playing.

hardware.summary: Run hands off by npp1993's (the author's) automated USB test rig on their Analog Rytm MKII, OS 1.74, as the rig's reports have it. 11 November 2026, this source: 25 cases pass on IL04 (sha256 662faad7), the module alone on a development build of the Modwerk base with a USB test link, loaded to RAM, against the references of 10 November: the AMP and FILTER screens, HLD in steps at three tempos and track speeds, FUNC + turn, ENV RESET's values, a kit save and reload; on the BD voice over USB audio, lengths by DEC, HLD and AUTO, OVR's level curve, the FILTER times, and ENV RESET AMP's fade before sequenced trigs, retrigs, swung, micro-timed and sound-locked trigs, with none for MIDI notes, the first trig after PLAY, muted trigs, lock trigs and failed conditions. The package's own image IA12 (sha256 e28ebdd4, plain base, no link) from RAM, MIDI notes and CCs only: hold, decay, attack and OVR read as on IL04. Idle load metered on the same day. 9 and 10 November: the same 25 cases on the earlier source of this version, and the comparison with stock.
limitations: Run by an automated rig, not by hand or by ear; pads were not played.
Loaded to RAM: no boot from flash. The package's own image ran with MIDI notes and CCs only, without keys, screens or the sequencer.
No power cycle, project save and load, +Drive sound, external MIDI clock, pattern change or probability condition.
The comparison with stock (OVR's curve, the FILTER times) was run on the earlier source of this version, 10 November 2026.
The audio load was metered with the sequencer stopped only. Duration not recorded.

tests.summary: On the author's Analog Rytm MKII (OS 1.74), by their automated USB test rig, as reported: 25 cases pass on 11 November 2026 on IL04 (this source on a development base with a USB test link, from RAM), as on 9 and 10 November on the earlier source: the AMP and FILTER screens, HLD in steps, lengths by DEC and HLD, OVR's curve, the FILTER times, and ENV RESET AMP's fade across sequenced trigs, retrigs, swing, micro timing, sound locks, mutes and conditions. The package's own image from RAM with notes and CCs only. Idle load metered. Not run: pads, a power cycle, a boot from flash. See TESTING.md.
